source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]

        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    frame = grid[r0][c0]
    inner_points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
                    if r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1 and v not in (0, frame)]
    if not inner_points:
        return out
    inner = grid[inner_points[0][0]][inner_points[0][1]]

              r0, c0, len(grid) - 1 - r1, len(grid[0]) - 1 - c1)
    for r in range(r0 - pad, r1 + pad + 1):
        for c in range(c0 - pad, c1 + pad + 1):
            if not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1):
